requirement: Every output is a record the next program can read
acceptance: every row has the listed fields with the listed types and Likert scores from 1 to 5
why_this_threshold: one unreadable record stops the next program
alternative_considered: so a false pass costs a crash downstream
column9: allowing 95%, rejected because the failures would be silent

requirement: Reports state the numbers in the source data correctly
acceptance: every golden-set report contains its expected figure
why_this_threshold: a wrong figure in a report is the failure users act on
alternative_considered: and the set is only six items so one miss is 17%
column9: 5 of 6, rejected because a wrong figure is a false pass we cannot afford

requirement: Reports read like a government report
acceptance: no row uses the hyperbole words from the manual quality control script
why_this_threshold: the word list is short and exact so any hit is a real break
alternative_considered: and a false fail only costs a rewrite
column9: allowing up to 10% of rows, rejected because the list is already narrow

requirement: The system declines questions the data cannot answer
why_this_threshold: one answered out-of-scope question is an invented answer
alternative_considered: and a false pass here reaches a user
column9: 90% of refusals, rejected because each miss is a made-up answer

requirement: The AI judge rates accuracy the way a person does
acceptance: the judge is within 1 point of the human rating on at least 80% of a sample of 10 or more
threshold: 80% within 1 point on at least 10 items
why_this_threshold: we want most scores close without demanding exact matches on a 5-point scale
alternative_considered: and ten items is the smallest sample where one disagreement moves the rate by 10 points
column9: exact agreement of 70%, rejected because adjacent scores are noise on a 5-point scale

requirement: Reports are short enough to read in a briefing
acceptance: every report is 60 words or fewer
why_this_threshold: a briefing reader stops after a short paragraph
alternative_considered: and a long report is a false fail that only costs an edit
column9: 100 words, rejected because the briefing reader stops earlier
